page_title: LEC 0-0 VER | Lecce v Verona 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+4' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lecce.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martin Frese (Verona) was quite harsh and Rosario Abisso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
86' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Gift Orban and he is replaced by Cheikh Niasse (Verona).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) comes onto the pitch for Medon Berisha.
86' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
85' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the corner kick, but Lorenzo Montipo reads it well and stops the effort.

84' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Corner kick. Lecce will have an opportunity.
83' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Lorenzo Montipo, who makes a comfortable save.
80' Referee Rosario Abisso signals NO PENALTY for Lecce after a VAR review!
78' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Lecce! Let's see what he decides.
77' Francesco Camarda (Lecce) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
77' Substitution. Lameck Banda leaves the pitch and is replaced by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce).
76' A cross from the by-line finds Martin Frese (Verona) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
75' The foul by Lameck Banda (Lecce) was seen by Rosario Abisso who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
74' Paolo Zanetti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amin Sarr (Verona) replacing Giovane.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Martin Frese (Verona) is coming onto the pitch as Domagoj Bradaric cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' The linesman signals that Medon Berisha (Lecce) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
72' Medon Berisha (Lecce) will take a corner kick.
71' Medon Berisha (Lecce) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

70' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. The ball is cleared after Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

69' A pass travels right across the box to Rafik Belghali (Verona) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the left post, but Wladimiro Falcone denies him with a decent save.
67' Referee Rosario Abisso sees the trip by Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lecce are awarded a free kick.
66' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Nikola Stulic is replaced by Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tete Morente trots off the pitch and is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
65' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Lorenzo Montipo.
64' Handball! A player from Verona handled the ball.
62' Antoine Bernede (Verona) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.

61' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
59' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:3. The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
58' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
58' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Rafik Belghali (Verona) offside.
56' Lameck Banda (Lecce) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
55' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Abdou Harroui walks off the pitch to be replaced by Antoine Bernede (Verona).
54' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
53' The referee blows his whistle after Tete Morente (Lecce) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.

51' The most active player in today's match is definitely Antonino Gallo (Lecce). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
50' Medon Berisha (Lecce) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Lecce will have a throw-in.
49' Medon Berisha (Lecce) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
47' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Rosario Abisso has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Medon Berisha (Lecce) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
45+2' Lameck Banda (Lecce) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+2' Giovane (Verona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Medon Berisha (Lecce) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
44' Verona are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
43' What was Nicolas Valentini (Verona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
42' Rafik Belghali (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

42' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul. Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) makes a strong challenge and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul.
40' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
37' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is penalised for holding. Rosario Abisso signals a set piece.
35' Gift Orban (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts the ball.
34' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
31' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) for his blatant foul.
31' Lameck Banda (Lecce) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
30' The game is interrupted now, Lameck Banda (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

29' Gift Orban (Verona) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Wladimiro Falcone, who makes a glorious save!
27' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
26' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

26' Gift Orban (Verona) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
24' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Medon Berisha (Lecce) sends it out of play.

24' Lameck Banda (Lecce) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Lorenzo Montipo. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
21' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Nicolas Valentini (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play.

19' Rafik Belghali (Verona) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the right post. That would have been a great goal!
18' Nikola Stulic (Lecce) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Abdou Harroui (Verona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
17' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Medon Berisha (Lecce) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

16' Tete Morente (Lecce) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Tete Morente (Lecce) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lecce.

14' CHANCE! Medon Berisha (Lecce) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Danilo Veiga. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
13' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a cross in and finds Nikola Stulic inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
12' Medon Berisha (Lecce) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

11' Victor Nelsson (Verona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Rosario Abisso no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Lecce, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
10' Medon Berisha (Lecce) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender.
9' Medon Berisha (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
8' Lecce players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
6' What an amazing save by Lorenzo Montipo! Lameck Banda (Lecce) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot low towards the middle of the target, but fails.
5' Abdou Harroui (Verona) is penalised for a foul. Rosario Abisso had a clear view and blows his whistle.
4' Rafik Belghali (Verona) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
3' Lameck Banda (Lecce) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
1' Giovane (Verona) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Verona will kick the game off.
Rosario Abisso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
